about: Phase 2 of the live zone (docs/V3-LIVE-ZONE-BRIEF-2026-10-27.md in the strategy repo): other players on screen. The presence service (server/presence/, node, NOT in the game bundle) holds who is where in memory and sends each client the nearby others; it decides nothing that pays, and others have no collider and play no part in the fight. Lifted from V1 (frankendom-main origins/presence/presence-rules-defs.json, interest.ts, server.ts; origins/preview/presence-client.ts, remote-track.ts): the rules below are V1's rows with the same ids and values, minus the account, save, worn, warp, town and writer rows V3 has no use for, plus walkHalfCm, giveUp, retryBaseMs, retryMaxMs, sweepEveryMs, remoteSnap, remoteExpire, and the drawing rows (src/presence/draw.ts): drawMax (most other players drawn at once, nearest first), drawIdle (a remote slower than this stands), drawSmooth (the gait speed easing, per second), animIdle/animWalk/animRun (the anim byte the hero sends: 1 stands, 2 walks, 3 runs) with animRunMps (the hero speed from which he runs), poseMinDtMs (the shortest gap the hero speed is measured over), drawDtMaxS (the longest frame step the draw loop takes), drawContact (the ready pose's contact argument for a drawn body). `query`: ?presence=<ws or wss URL> opens the client (a dynamically imported chunk, default OFF: with no ?presence= nothing is fetched); ?presence=1 means this page's own host at `path`. `frame`: world (0,0) sits at centreCm of a u16 centimetre frame, sizeCm wide. walkHalfCm: a pose farther than this from the centre on either axis is refused as a jump. `poseGlobal`: the name of the function on globalThis that returns the hero's { x, z, heading, anim } in metres (the seam src/presence/draw.ts installs, only with ?presence=). `protocol`: the WebSocket subprotocol name both sides speak. `softCap`/`hardCap` are yard-sized (20/24) for the shared-VPS deploy (deploy/presence/); V1 used 80/100. `host`: the address the service binds (loopback; the one env override is PRESENCE_HOST). maxWriteBytes: a socket with more than this queued unsent is closed (4010), and a ping counts against perSecond like any frame.
spawnAbout: ZONE FRAME (fix: the seam used to send the pit's own frame, around world (0, 0), while the zone's yard and pit stand at x 190 to 235). The wire now carries ZONE-frame metres: the page adds the pit's centre in the zone row (src/zone/spawns.ts pitOrigin, from data/zones + data/respawn.json world) to the hero before it is sent and takes it off a remote before it is drawn (src/presence/chunk.ts `origin`), so the offset has one source and is not copied here. `spawn`: where the SERVICE places a join, in zone-frame metres (the pit's centre, 226 / 47 in zone 1), so a first pose from the pit is a short step, not a teleport; a test pins it to pitOrigin. Only ?presence= pages are affected; a page without it sends and draws nothing.
originsAbout: The WebSocket Origin allow-list (server/presence/server.ts, src/presence/rows.ts originAllowed). A browser always sends Origin; a page on any other site is refused with 403 (refused.origin) so it cannot open a socket as a visitor. `allowed`: exact origins. `devHosts`: hostnames allowed on any port over http or https (local dev). `allowMissing`: a client that sends no Origin header (not a browser: the bots, tests, curl) is let through, because only browsers can be driven by a third-party page.
